project.name: codenameone-rive-schema-gen
project.description: Build-time generator of the Rive object model. Reads the pinned copy of rive-runtime's generated C++ base headers in src/main/schema/rive-runtime-generated.zip (MIT; the commit is in UPSTREAM.txt beside it) and writes the runtime's Base classes and placeholders (codenameone-rive-runtime) and the transcoder's RiveSchema (codenameone-rive-transcoder) into their target/generated-sources. Never shipped inside an application: both consumers declare it provided and optional.
